تتحاشي (form VI)
# تَتَحَاشَيْ (tataḥāšay) /ta.ta.ħaː.ʃaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# تُتَحَاشَيْ (tutaḥāšay) /tu.ta.ħaː.ʃaj/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
